## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and relevant plan or decision.

## Verification

List the checks run and their results. Identify skipped or failed checks and
required prerequisites; link existing evidence where useful.

## Compatibility and follow-up

Describe any contract, migration, security or deployment impact and remaining
work. Follow [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and use the private process in
[SECURITY](../SECURITY.md) for vulnerability details.
